name: ResumeSkills
title_zh: 把求职全流程打包成可复用的技能集
tagline_zh: 简历、ATS、面试、求职策略，一次装齐。别让 AI 只帮你改错别字，让它从投递前到谈薪都替你铺路。
tagline_en: Resume, ATS, interviews, job-search strategy in one kit. Stop using AI for typos—let it pave the road from.
desc_en: A collection of AI agent skills focused on resume optimization, job applications, and career development. Built for job seekers, career changers, and professionals who want Claude Code to help with resume writing, ATS optimization, interview prep, and strategic job search.
why_zh: 按求职阶段拆成独立 skill，可单点调用也可串联。针对 ATS 解析规则和面试追问逻辑做了专门适配。
why_en: Modular skills per job-search stage—call one or chain them. Built around ATS parsing rules and interview follow-up logic, not.
limit_zh: 只覆盖英文求职市场，中文简历格式与国内 ATS 规则未适配。技能产出为策略与文本草稿，不保证投递系统兼容性。
limit_en: English job market only; CN resume formats & domestic ATS untested. Outputs are drafts/strategy, not guaranteed ATS-compliant—verify against each.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
